Soup kitchen cheddar and onion rolls.d: A pull-apart pan, baked this morning with sharp cheese on top.
Soup kitchen cheddar and onion rolls.note: Good for dunking in the stew.

Manhole cover mini pizzas.d: Little rounds of tomato sauce and mozzarella, pepperoni laid on in a crosshatch.
Manhole cover mini pizzas.note: Cut like the covers out front.

The Reverend's soup kitchen stew.d: Chuck braised for hours with carrot, celery, onion and potato. Italian bread to mop up.
The Reverend's soup kitchen stew.note: What's left goes to the Reverend's shelter.

Greenwich Village cider doughnuts.d: Boiled-down apple juice in the batter, fried and rolled in cinnamon sugar.
Greenwich Village cider doughnuts.note: Seconds once everybody has had firsts.

Glowing green cordial.d: Lime cordial and tonic water, poured over a glass full of ice.
